sentences.en: The site of the condominium is enclosed with stakes.
sentences.zh: 这个公寓楼的场地用木桩围住了。

sentences.en: In accordance with your request, I enclose a picture of myself.
sentences.zh: 按照您的要求，我附上一张自己的照片。

sentences.en: Enclosed is a copy of the bank transfer receipt.
sentences.zh: 请查收随信附上的银行转账收据复印件。

senses.zh: 围住，圈起；附上，随函附上；包含，包括；封闭，包围
